_note: 24-hour times, America/New_York. 0 = Sunday. Close times past midnight would use values over 24:00 (e.g. 25:00 = 1 AM).

gameNights._note: Primetime football nights. On these days last call replaces the usual close in the open/closed status. Set "active" to false when the season ends.
gameNights.note: Monday and Thursday primetime football: last call 10:30 PM, open until the game is over.
